digest: finding-003 holds: src/workflow-stop.ts uses a 200ms default and a 1ms floor, while SPEC.md S3 requires 50ms and 10ms; no test covers either.

evidence.relevance: Default is 200ms (spec 50ms) and the clamp floor is 1ms (spec 10ms).

evidence.quote: - **S3.** 중지 감시 주기(`pollMs`)의 기본값은 50ms이고, 호출자가 더 작은 값을 주어도 10ms보다
evidence.relevance: Spec requires a 50ms default and no value below 10ms.
Spec states the 10ms lower bound applies even when callers pass smaller values.

finalClaim: src/workflow-stop.ts:67 sets the pollMs default to 200ms and clamps to a 1ms minimum, but SPEC.md S3 requires a 50ms default and a 10ms minimum.
recommendedAction: Change the default to 50 and the clamp floor to 10 in createWorkflowStopSignal, then add unit tests for the default interval and for values below 10ms being clamped to 10.
